pages.src: {employee_id}: 400 kinds on file. The asset map is mostly full.
Mostly. The last few are hiding. Assets do that.
Four hundred kinds, {employee_id}. The ledger needs a volume two.
Volume one goes in the lobby. Under glass.
{employee_id}: 400 kinds logged. Asset value is enormous.
Enormous is a technical term. Accounting agrees.
{employee_id}: 400 kinds registered. Fifty to go.
Fifty more line items. The ledger is stretching.
{employee_id}: 450 kinds! Peak asset value. The board is speechless.
They'd thank you, but they don't know your name. Neither do we.
{employee_id}: 450 kinds! Asset value has reached the top.
Your reward is a very full spreadsheet.

450 kinds on file, {employee_id}. The
board stood up and cheered.

Then they sat down. The cheering was for
the assets.
{employee_id}: 450 kinds logged. Company value: maximum.
You're still employed. That's the bonus.
{employee_id}: No Breaks Between, closed. Every Master beaten.
Back to back. Asset value hasn't sat down since.
{employee_id}: arena run complete. No healing, no losses.
Maximum value, minimum downtime. The dream.
Aurelith arena logged, {employee_id}. The doors stayed open.
We said we'd come back when it was profitable.
{employee_id}: every Battle Master down in one go.
The board wants that framed. The result, that is.
{employee_id}: There Will Be Cake, closed. The office is open.
There is cake. For the field team. And the assets.
{employee_id}: the field team is back at their desks.
Staff headcount restored. Asset count still higher.
Welcome-back task logged, {employee_id}.

Cake Friday is back. Your slice is
pending sign-off.
{employee_id}: Brookhollow office reopened.
Normal service resumes. The grass still needs walking in.
{employee_id}: final match with Ron logged. Six on six.
Twelve company assets. One clean result. Lovely.
{employee_id}: Ron beaten on the arena steps. He's coming along.

Two staff, one trip. The travel budget
is pleased.
Last rival result filed, {employee_id}. Ron's tally closes.
We'll archive it. Next to the bin rota.
{employee_id}: rival file closed. Asset value: undefeated.
Ron says he's coming. Two numbers, one lift.
